requirements.RQ01: Acquire/resolve exact PDF bytes and SHA-256; measure pages; retain original URL, source family, publisher dates and acquisition time. Record failed sources without fabricated text.
requirements.RQ02: Segment contents, body paragraphs, examples, tables and footnotes with page/paragraph locators. Preserve raw extraction and mark uncertain boundaries; headings alone remain navigation.
requirements.RQ03: Review candidate terms against body evidence. For each retain preferred label, aliases if evidenced, benefit/date/jurisdiction scope, definition or definition gap, evidence and unreviewed status. Resolve reuse of existing terms explicitly.
requirements.RQ04: Review possible relationships using exact source passages. Retain direction, predicate meaning, rationale, conditions/exceptions, source role and evidence. A supported proposal or reasoned abstention closes the research task; no relationship quota forces an assertion.
requirements.RQ05: Record source publication, revision, acquisition and stated effective dates separately, including precision. Inspect transitional text, old examples, memo changes and incorporation claims; unknown applicability remains unknown.
requirements.RQ06: Extract explicit legislation, case-law, memo and cross-guide citations with exact citation strings and locators. Resolve work/provision/version separately; mark unacquired, ambiguous, broken or conflict states. Do not claim legal interpretation from a URL.
requirements.RQ07: Author and execute one chapter source-grounding case and one boundary case, linked to existing persona/story/question routes. Separate deterministic checks, model outputs and specialist judgement.
requirements.RQ08: Publish a source-unit coverage row with task state, counts, attempted areas, unresolved issues, evidence links and the reviewer type. Reconcile counts against the pinned 331-unit denominator.
requirements.RQ09: Compare shared terminology only through scoped mapping candidates. Record DMG/ADM, legacy/New Style, Pension Credit/UC and territorial distinctions; do not infer equivalence or transfer a rule.

negative_controls.NC01: Remove supporting source or quote: a substantive relation cannot pass evidence validation.
negative_controls.NC02: Supply only a heading/contents entry or a spare chapter: retain navigation or a gap; do not create a validated definition or rule.
negative_controls.NC03: Replace benefit/regime/jurisdiction with a similarly named one: reject unqualified equivalence and preserve the scope distinction.
negative_controls.NC04: Change page, paragraph or quotation while retaining a valid hash elsewhere: provenance checks must fail.
negative_controls.NC05: Use an old memo or amendment date as the sole evidence of supersession: keep applicability unresolved.
negative_controls.NC06: Substitute publication/capture month for a precise effective date: preserve date role and precision; reject invented day/applicability.
negative_controls.NC07: Reverse a directed assessment-sequence edge: require source evidence for that direction; do not treat it as symmetric.
negative_controls.NC08: Offer an isolated worked-example rate or duration as universal current law: flag the example/date/scope and abstain from a universal claim.
negative_controls.NC09: Ask for CPAG subscriber interpretation from public contents metadata: state missing substantive evidence; do not invent it.
negative_controls.NC10: Treat an abbreviation, instrument URL or inaccessible provision as acquired legal content: report the missing acquisition/applicability evidence.
negative_controls.NC11: Change machine-reviewed or unreviewed to specialist-accepted without a reviewer receipt: fail status promotion.
negative_controls.NC12: Ask the research bundle to decide entitlement or calculate an award: keep the answer within source discovery and identified missing evidence.
negative_controls.NC13: Overwrite original source bytes or silently replace a frozen snapshot: hash/lineage checks must fail.

execution_contract.authority_rule: Machine completion never sets specialist-accepted. Source-unavailable is accounted for but prevents source-complete status.
execution_contract.no_automatic_retry: A completed attempt is immutable; a retry is a new attempt linked to its predecessor.
execution_contract.predicate_rule: Use existing approved predicate definitions only; the three capital-specific predicates cannot be generalised to other benefits without a separately reviewed vocabulary extension.
execution_contract.unchanged_baseline: Do not reset acquired original Pension Credit source evidence or specialised review state; reconcile it by hash and append new outcomes.

source_complete: All 331 source URLs resolve to verified acquired bytes, or report source-accounted-with-failures instead.
Measured page counts and extraction outcomes reconcile to original PDFs; zero-text pages remain visibly unresolved unless inspected.
Census, original acquisition and refreshed source observations retain separate identities.
research_coverage_complete: All 331 source units have terminal profile outcomes; all 78 substantive units have RQ01–RQ08 outcomes and RQ09 where listed.
All156 chapter evaluation tasks have an actual receipt or a stated blocker; report passed/failed/not-run separately.
All candidate terms and relations carry exact source evidence or terminate as an explicit rejected/gap outcome.
All11 family checks and six cross-cutting tasks have receipts or blockers; all 8 personas,10 stories and14 questions map to cases.
Published coverage denominator is source units and attempted requirements, not all possible concepts or all law.
specialist_accepted: Only explicit accepted statements/tasks with qualified reviewer receipts count as accepted.
Report reviewed units, accepted/rejected proposals and outstanding disagreements separately; no automatic whole-chapter promotion.
publication_ready: Pinned-context and all-assertion validation, source hashes, deterministic generation and negative controls pass.
Full-corpus load/search/graph performance is measured; split source families or bound projections if current consumer limits are exceeded.
Exact content bytes and representative P0/P1/P2 routes are checked in the actual consumer; website/WebMCP/voice require separate receipts.
The source-complete/research-complete/specialist-accepted labels are independently computed and displayed.
